description: This Java class 'EmailDataValidator' provides validation logic for email campaign scheduling, including JSON request validation, email format checking, email recipients validation, and date parsing according to specified formats. It facilitates validation for create and update operations for scheduled email jobs within the Fineract platform.

classes.name: EmailDataValidator
classes.description: A component class responsible for validating email campaign data JSON requests, email formats, recipients, and date formats within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: validateCreateRequest
methods.description: Validates the JSON request payload for creating a new scheduled email campaign, checking required fields, formats, and date parsing.

methods.name: validateUpdateRequest
methods.description: Validates the JSON payload when updating an existing scheduled email campaign, allowing partial updates with validation.

methods.name: isValidEmail
methods.description: Checks if a given email string matches the email regex pattern to determine if it is valid.

methods.name: validateEmailRecipients
methods.description: Splits a comma-separated string of email addresses and validates each, returning a set of valid email addresses.

methods.name: validateStretchyReportParamMap
methods.description: Parses a JSON string into a HashMap to validate the stretchy report parameters; returns null on failure.
